sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7817 of 2023

Petitioner :- Rahul Prajapati
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Tinku Singh,Vijay Singh Gour

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1. Heard Ms. Tinku Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Rajesh Kumar Sachan, learned State Lw Officer for the State respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 31.08.2022, registered as Case Crime No. 338 of 2022, under Sections 420, 379 IPC, Police Station Civil Lines, District Muzaffarnagar.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.
3. Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner is not named in the first information report.

It is further submitted that no notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. was served on Rahul Prajapati vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44107098/
1 the petitioner.

entities.text: Rahul Prajapati vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, learned State Law Officer on instructions submitted that non-bailable warrants have been issued against the petitioner; he is wanted in criminal case; his name has been figured out during investigation, therefore, a cognizable offence is made out where the public is being defrauded by changing the ATM cards.
It is submitted that in such matter no interference is warranted.
5. We find substance in the argument of learned State Law Officer.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
